title: Biotechnology Ethics: Germline Modification and Human Dignity

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: The advent of CRISPR-Cas9 revolutionized biotechnology, making targeted genomic alteration routine. Bioethical demarcation distinguishes *szomatikus génterápia* (treating a living patient's disease) from *csíravonal-módosítás* (altering reproductive cells).

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Germline alteration produces heritable changes (*örökíthető genetikai módosítás*), raising grave risks of neo-eugenics (*új eugenika*) and violating the Oviedo Convention on Human Rights and Biomedicine.
